title: C++: Decorator Pattern
description: Implement the Decorator pattern to add responsibilities to objects dynamically.

steps.title: Decorator Pattern
steps.description: Define an interface `Coffee` with double cost() and string description(). Implement `SimpleCoffee` (cost 2.0). Create decorators `MilkDecorator` (+0.5, adds 'Milk') and `SugarDecorator` (+0.25, adds 'Sugar'). Build a coffee with milk and sugar.
hints: Decorator inherits from Coffee and wraps a Coffee reference.
MilkDecorator: cost = wrapped.cost() + 0.5, description = wrapped.description() + " + Milk"

verification.failureMessage: Print decorated coffee description and cost
